title: Practice 4: One direction, or round and about

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Did you go anywhere on Thanksgiving Day?
exercises.why: **ездил** — past tense (masculine) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Ellie walked the rainswept streets home.
exercises.why: **шла** — past tense (feminine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.ru: Элли ___ по мокрым от дождя улицам домой.

exercises.q: My uncle has a business trip to Aomori tomorrow.
exercises.why: **едет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.ru: Мой дядя завтра ___ в командировку в Аомори.

exercises.q: Golden words are often followed by leaden acts.
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.ru: За золотыми словами часто ___ свинцовые дела.

exercises.q: He took off at full speed without saying where he was going.
exercises.why: **едет** — present tense (3rd person singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).
exercises.ru: Он умчался на всех парах, не сказав, куда ___.

exercises.q: I frequently go to the islands of Menorca and Ibiza.
exercises.why: **езжу** — present tense (1st person singular) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.ru: Я часто ___ на остров Менорка и на остров Ибица.

exercises.q: This morning, my friend and I went to buy airline tickets.
exercises.why: **ездили** — past tense (plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.ru: Сегодня утром мы с другом ___ покупать авиабилеты.

exercises.q: My nose runs whenever I have a cold.
exercises.why: **идут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.ru: Каждый раз, когда я простужаюсь, у меня ___ сопли.

exercises.q: Мы медленно ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) к ним.
exercises.why: **шли** — past tense (plural) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).

exercises.q: I am an idealist. I don't know where I'm going but I'm on my way.
exercises.why: **иду** — present tense (1st person singular) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.ru: Я идеалист. Я не знаю, куда ___, но я на своём пути.

exercises.q: Ai and Mariko are close friends. They go everywhere together.
exercises.why: **ходят** — present tense (3rd person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.ru: Ай и Марико — близкие подруги. Они повсюду ___ вместе.

exercises.q: Сколько часов ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) до Палау?
exercises.why: **лететь** — infinitive, one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: How many hours is the flight to Palau?

exercises.q: У него ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way) пена изо рта.
exercises.why: **шла** — past tense (feminine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: He was foaming at the mouth.

exercises.q: Снаряд за снарядом ___ (лететь — to fly, one way) в крепость.
exercises.why: **летел** — past tense (masculine) of лететь: one-direction verb (many directions: летать).
exercises.prompt: Shell after shell smashed into the fort.

exercises.q: ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) слишком дорого.
exercises.why: **летать** — infinitive, many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Оса ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) по комнате.
exercises.why: **летала** — past tense (feminine) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
exercises.prompt: A wasp was flying round the room.

exercises.q: По комнате ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) оса.
exercises.why: **летала** — past tense (feminine) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
exercises.prompt: A wasp was flying round the room.

exercises.q: Чайки ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) над морем.
exercises.why: **летали** — past tense (plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
exercises.prompt: Gulls were flying above the sea.

exercises.q: Над водой ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) стрекозы.
exercises.why: **летали** — past tense (plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
exercises.prompt: Dragonflies were flying over the water.

exercises.q: Куда именно вы ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general)?
exercises.why: **ходили** — past tense (plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
